referenceFunction.includedProcesses:
Wind turbine moving parts (without tower and substructure), at site including manufacturing, transports, installation, replacements, decommission and waste treatement. Calculated for FU of 1p. Data are based on the plant IEA reference 15MW offshore wind turbine. The distance to installation port is assumed to be 80 km. Assumed lifetime is 25 years.
Main data source for material composition: Renewable Energy Material Property Database, REMPD (Cooperman et al., 2023) IEA Wind TCP Task 37 Definition of the IEA Wind 15-Megawatt Offshore Reference Wind Turbine (Technical Report NREL/TP-5000-75698). IEA Wind TCP. https://www.nrel.gov/docs/fy20osti/75698.pdf (Gaertner, et al., 2020)
referenceFunction.name: Wind turbine 15MW, offshore, moving parts
